BrochureContent.Content:
HJ Byrne are delighted to present this spacious, light filled two bedroom furnished duplex apartment available immediately.
Tastefully decorated with high quality finish throughout.
Master bedroom ensuite with one single bedroom, fitted wardrobes and ample storage facilities.

The apartment is located within easy reach of Dundrum Town Centre and Marlay Park. The LUAS green line at Glencairn is a 15 minutes walk away. Several Dublin bus routes run close by, providing access to the Sandyford Business District, the N11 and on to the City Centre. 
Surface level car parking is available.

Viewing comes highly recommended and by appointment.
